Navigation to /login route occurs

steps.context: Proper heading hierarchy aids screen readers

steps.description: Verify all interactive elements are keyboard accessible
steps.context: Tab navigation should work for all buttons/links

steps.description: Verify visible focus indicators on interactive elements
steps.context: Users should see which element has focus

steps.description: Verify sufficient color contrast ratios
steps.context: Text should be readable against backgrounds

test_cases.input: Check for single h1 element on homepage
test_cases.expected: Exactly one h1 element exists (main headline)
Headings follow proper hierarchy (h1 > h2 > h3) without skipping levels

test_cases.input: Check all buttons have accessible names
test_cases.expected: All buttons have text content or aria-label

test_cases.input: Check all images have alt text
test_cases.expected: All img elements have alt attributes
All interactive elements (buttons, links) are reachable via Tab key

test_cases.input: Check focus visible on interactive elements
test_cases.expected: Focus indicator is visible when tabbing through elements
